summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K disclosing multiple 'Managers Transactions' under EU Market Abuse Regulation, reporting the receipt of Nokia shares by board members as part of the annual fee settlement approved at the April 9, 2026 AGM, with approximately 40% of fees paid in shares. Each notification reports a receipt of share-based incentive with no cash price per share. No corporate action, acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine compliance filing for director share compensation, not a special situation.
